lyrics:
[Intro: simple piano figure, soft pad]

[Verse 1: high clear male tenor, gentle]
Another lobby, another key card in a sleeve
Same carpet, same painting of the sea
The ice machine is humming down the hall
I'm lying here composing this to you

[Verse 2: bass and light drums enter]
They ask me at the bar if I get lonely
I say I've got a call at nine o'clock
You tell me what the dog did, what the mail brought
And I can see the kitchen while you talk

[Chorus: full band, voice soaring]
Room two-fourteen, yours as always
Different city, same old vow
I count the nights in little soaps and coffee
I'm still yours, I'm still yours now
Home by Friday
Yours, as always

[Verse 3: voice warmer, guitar answering]
Twenty years of airports and of rental cars
Of birthdays on a screen, I know the cost
But you have never once asked me to prove it
And I have never once been lost

[Chorus: full band, harmonies]
Room two-fourteen, yours as always
Different city, same old vow
I count the nights in little soaps and coffee
I'm still yours, I'm still yours now
Home by Friday
Yours, as always

[Guitar Solo: singing lead guitar, wordless vocal over it]
Whoa-oh-oh, oh-oh
Whoa-oh-oh, oh-oh

[Final Chorus: biggest, last word held]
Room two-fourteen, yours as always
Different city, same old vow
I count the nights in little soaps and coffee
I'm still yours, I'm still yours now
Home by Friday
Yours, as always

[Outro: piano figure, a phone ringing once, "Hey. It's nine."]
